subject: Auth service token refresh failures causing 401 cascade
body: PagerDuty alert INC-5518. Auth service returning 401 for valid refresh tokens. Root cause: Redis cache TTL misconfiguration in commit a1b2c3. Rolled back at 09:45 UTC.

comments.author: U007
comments.body: Root cause identified: commit a1b2c3 changed Redis TTL from 3600 to 60 (seconds). Rolling back now.

comments.author: U001
comments.body: Rollback confirmed. Token refresh success rate back to 99.97%. Scheduling postmortem for Friday.

resolution: Rolled back commit a1b2c3. Redis cache TTL restored to 3600s from 60s (typo in config).
